_comment: Blank bell schedule. Copy this file, give the copy a name like bell-schedule.json, delete the "sample": true line, and fill in your own day types. As shipped it declares no school days at all, so nothing is displayed until you fill it in.
_comment_school: Your school name. It is only used to tell one schedule file from another.
_comment_timezone: Your local timezone name, for example America/Chicago.
_comment_day_types: One entry per kind of school day. The key is a short id you choose (for example bobcat_hour, friday, homeroom_first, pep_rally) and the value has a label plus an ordered list of blocks. Copy an entry from _example_day_types below to get started.
_comment_weekday_default: Which day type each weekday normally gets. Keys are numbers as text: "0" is Monday through "6" is Sunday. A weekday you leave out is not a school day.
_comment_date_overrides: Single dates that use a different day type, in YYYY-MM-DD form. These win over weekday_default.

_example_day_types._comment: Reference only. Nothing in here is read. Copy an entry into day_types above and change the ids, labels, and times to your own.

your_day_type_id.label: What to call this kind of day

blocks._comment: id is the short name you will key the day plan by. kind is one of class, homeroom, bobcat_hour, lunch, advisory, assembly, other. start and end are HH:MM on a 24-hour clock, so 1:05pm is 13:05.
blocks.label: 1st Period

blocks._comment: A period with A and B lunch inside it. Sequential sub-blocks have to fill the parent exactly: the first starts when the parent starts, the last ends when the parent ends, with no gaps and no overlap.
blocks.label: 4th Period

blocks._comment: A block that holds several things happening at once, such as a lunch-and-tutorials hour. Leave blocks empty: what is on offer changes week to week, so it is day plan content, not schedule content.
blocks.label: Bobcat Hour
